title: External beam radiotherapy of recurrent glioma: radiation tolerance of the human brain
authors: Sminia P, Mayer R
scope: Recurrent glioma (mostly high-grade/GBM) re-irradiation series 1996-2011; normal brain necrosis vs cumulative EQD2 (alpha/beta 2)
notes: Literature-level analysis of study medians; necrosis thresholds are observed associations, not validated limits. Update of Mayer & Sminia 2008. Original XML in sources/sminia-mayer-2012.xml; .txt is tag-stripped text of the same XML.

title: Reirradiation of recurrent brain tumors: a review by the ESTRO CNS Focus Group
authors: De Pietro R, Clerici E, Harat M, et al. (Ehret F, corresponding)
scope: Non-systematic review of reirradiation of recurrent CNS tumours EXCLUDING gliomas (meningioma, ependymoma, brain metastases, PitNET), plus general sections on recovery and radiation necrosis
notes: Brain cumulative-EQD2 statements cite the glioblastoma literature (De Pietro 2023 [1], Minniti 2021 [82], Stiefel 2021 [89]). Optic statements cite QUANTEC (Mayo 2010) and HyTEC (Milano 2021), i.e. largely primary-course data.

title: The evolving role of reirradiation in the management of recurrent brain tumors
authors: De Pietro R, Zaccaro L, Marampon F, Tini P, De Felice F, Minniti G
scope: Narrative review: recurrent glioma (GBM), LGG, ependymoma, medulloblastoma, meningioma, brain metastases reirradiation
notes: Secondary source. Cites Niyazi 2013 OAR values as 'EQD2'; primary paper reports summed maximum point doses (see niyazi-eud-2013).

title: Current status and recent advances in reirradiation of glioblastoma
authors: Minniti G, Niyazi M, Alongi F, Navarria P, Belka C
scope: Recurrent glioblastoma reirradiation (SRS, hypofractionated SRT, conventional SRT)
notes: Pooled literature tables of cumulative EQD2 vs necrosis rate; alpha/beta not explicitly stated in text for cumulative EQD2.

title: Analysis of equivalent uniform dose (EUD) and conventional radiation treatment parameters after primary and re-irradiation of malignant glioma
authors: Niyazi M, Karin I, Söhn M, Nachbichler SB, Lang P, Belka C, Ganswindt U
scope: 58 adults, recurrent malignant glioma, re-RT 36 Gy/2 Gy fractions, interval generally >6 months; cumulative OAR doses (summed, also with recovery factor 0.5)
notes: Cumulative values are simple sums of first and second course (nominal physical Gy; both courses conventionally fractionated); no relevant toxicity observed at median follow-up 265 days (short).

title: High-dose re-irradiation of intracranial lesions - Efficacy and safety including dosimetric analysis based on accumulated EQD2Gy dose EQD calculation
authors: Stiefel I, Schröder C, Tanadini-Lang S, Pytko I, Vu E, Klement RJ, Guckenberger M, Andratschke N
scope: 76 patients, repeated cranial RT for recurrent primary brain tumours (n=34) and brain metastases (n=42); voxel-wise accumulated EQD2 sum plans (rigid registration)
notes: Inconsistency: Methods state alpha/beta 2 Gy for brainstem/optic nerves and 3 Gy for body contour, but Table 2 labels brainstem/chiasm/optic-nerve values as Gy3 EQD2. Conclusions are authors' safety statements from observed toxicity, not tested limits.

title: Fractionated reirradiation of recurrent high-grade gliomas: Safety with higher reirradiation dose and larger targets
authors: LeCompte MC, Vuppala N, Reyes JM, Page B, Croog V, et al.
scope: 230 adults, recurrent WHO grade 3-4 glioma, conventionally fractionated reirradiation (SRS/SRT excluded), Johns Hopkins 2007-2022
notes: Institutional OAR constraints described in Methods; cumulative OAR maxima often computed by adding maximum point doses (conservative).

title: Proton-Based Re-Irradiation of Locally Recurrent Pediatric Brain Tumors in Close Proximity to the Brainstem
authors: (MedAustron group; see article)
scope: 11 children, recurrent ependymoma (6), ATRT (3), papillary tumour of pineal region (1), atypical meningioma (1) near brainstem; PBS proton re-RT 1.8-2.2 Gy(RBE)/fx, median interval 21 months
notes: Small series (n=11); planning goals individualized; cumulative doses reported as nominal Gy(RBE) sums, RBE 1.1. Authors not fully listed in my extraction - check article.

title: Reirradiation for Patients With Recurrent Ependymoma Across the Age Spectrum
authors: Sum YY, Bennett J, Ramaswamy V, Das A, Liu AP, Huang A, Tabori U, Dirks P, Nassiri F, Keilty DM, Tsang DS
scope: 48 patients (83% paediatric), recurrent ependymoma, photon RT2 (focal and/or CSI) after RT1 59.4 Gy
notes: Per-course (RT2) OAR maxima; explicitly no cumulative limits applied.

title: Temporally-Modulated Pulsed Radiation Therapy for Large-Volume Reirradiation of Recurrent Meningioma
authors: (see article)
scope: Recurrent meningioma, large-volume TMPRT (pulsed low-dose-rate) reirradiation
notes: OAR limits applied to TMPRT plan only; no cumulative limits.

title: A Prospective Study of Conventionally Fractionated Dose Constraints for Reirradiation of Primary Brain Tumors in Adults
authors: McGovern SL, Luo D, Johnson J, Nguyen K, Li J, et al.
scope: Adults, recurrent primary brain tumours (18/20 glioma), prospective composite (RT1+RT2) dose constraints by histology, interval and bevacizumab
notes: HIGH PRIORITY to obtain: the only prospective composite-constraint study. Abstract gives no constraint values. PMID 36596356.

title: Brain and Brain Stem Necrosis After Reirradiation for Recurrent Childhood Primary Central Nervous System Tumors: A PENTEC Comprehensive Review
authors: Ajithkumar T, Avanzo M, Yorke E, Tsang DS, Milano MT, Olch AJ, et al.
journal: International Journal of Radiation Oncology Biology Physics
scope: Children/AYA, recurrent primary CNS tumours (ependymoma, medulloblastoma, others); 17 studies, 449 patients
notes: HIGH PRIORITY to obtain. Abstract gives cumulative prescription EQD2 (alpha/beta 2) associations with necrosis; not extracted. PMID 38300187.

title: Reirradiation tolerance of the human brain
authors: Mayer R, Sminia P
journal: International Journal of Radiation Oncology Biology Physics
scope: Recurrent glioma reirradiation series 1996-2006; cumulative NTD (EQD2) of normal brain
notes: Not OA. Updated by the OA Sminia & Mayer 2012 paper (extracted). PMID 18037587.

title: Hypofractionated re-irradiation to the brainstem in children with recurrent brain tumors
authors: Waxweiler TV, Amini A, Vinogradskiy Y, Yeh N, Foreman NK, Hankinson TC, Liu AK
scope: 23 children, 28 tumours invading/abutting brainstem, hypofractionated re-RT 16-30 Gy in 2-5 fx
